Location: Dublar Char, Coastal area of Bay of Bengal Sundarban
If we look at world map or google map then we will find still some places which are distant from our general life. This place is at the corner of the Bay of Bengal and surrounded by Sundarban area (though farm from this largest mangrove forest).
